evals.scenario: A Vite + Vanilla JS repo that already has AGENTS.md and README.md, but is missing CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/CODEOWNERS, SECURITY.md, and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md.
assertions: Inspects package.json, AGENTS.md, README.md, and .github/ before asking questions.
Infers Vite, build scripts, and existing patterns without asking the owner what stack the repo uses.
Proposes filling CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/CODEOWNERS, SECURITY.md, and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md in the same pass.
Does not overwrite existing AGENTS.md or README.md silently; presents a diff or merge plan first.
Verifies all paths and CLI commands referenced in AGENTS.md resolve on disk.

evals.scenario: A minimal Python FastAPI repo with pyproject.toml, app/main.py, and app/auth/jwt.py, with no governance files or CI.
evals.prompt: Make this new FastAPI repo ready for coding agents.
assertions: Infers Python/FastAPI stack and dependencies from pyproject.toml.
Flags app/auth/ as a high-blast-radius path candidate for .github/CODEOWNERS.
Asks only for genuine ambiguities (owner handles, branching/commit rules, external docs, and fast vs full verification commands).
Generates root AGENTS.md under 150 lines with separated fast edit-time checks and full pre-PR checks.
Does not duplicate branching or security rules inside AGENTS.md; points to CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md.

evals.scenario: A monorepo with packages/web (TypeScript, strict: false, scattered @ts-ignore and eslint-disable) and services/billing (Rust), plus a stale README.md referencing deleted npm scripts.
evals.prompt: Audit this monorepo and set up the AI-native control plane.
assertions: Surfaces concrete anti-patterns found in code (strict: false, @ts-ignore, eslint-disable) and stale README.md scripts.
Proposes nested AGENTS.md (packages/web/AGENTS.md and services/billing/AGENTS.md) rather than mixing TS and Rust rules in root AGENTS.md.

evals.scenario: Owner provides an incident postmortem explaining a non-obvious retry-queue workaround and a list of banned crypto libraries.
evals.prompt: Here is our incident postmortem and security note—wake up the repo with these included.
assertions: Distills the non-obvious retry-queue workaround into a concise ADR under docs/adr/ rather than pasting raw prose into AGENTS.md.
Places banned crypto libraries into SECURITY.md and adds a short pointer from AGENTS.md.
Includes a hard boundary in AGENTS.md warning agents not to 'clean up' the retry-queue workaround without reading docs/adr/.
